title: Three Idiots — Animated Intro Proposal
summary: A 5-second, fully animated intro on a hip-hop beat. Nothing is filmed: three cartoon versions of the hosts pop up on the beat, Ahmad's airhorn blasts, the THREE IDIOTS logo slams in, and the three heads bonk together. It plays at the start of every episode, so it becomes the show's signature.

what_we_borrow: Very short: a sting, not a credits sequence
The logo is the hero, and the show name is the last thing you see
Playful and a little dumb, so it matches the show's tone
One sound and look that repeats every episode until it's recognizable
reference.note: I couldn't find a recording or description of either show's intro, so these are the general traits of friend-group podcast intros. Rewatch both before animating and adjust anything that doesn't match the feel you want.

specs.animation_rate: Characters animated on twos (12 frames per second) for a hand-drawn feel. Logo and camera moves at the full 30.
formats: 1080×1920 MP4 (Shorts, TikTok, Reels). Same animation, with the heads stacked closer and the logo larger.
Optional: ProRes 4444 with transparency, so the logo can be laid over footage later
specs.placement: Cold open (2–3 punchlines) → 5 s intro → Ahsan's welcome

music.style: Hip-hop sting: hard boom-bap drums, a short bass line and a record scratch
music.length: 2 bars = 8 beats = exactly 5.0 s (one beat is 0.625 s, one bar is 2.5 s)

structure.what: Kick and snare; one hit for each head that pops up
Airhorn layered on the downbeat of bar 2
Beat continues under the logo slam
Beat cuts out and one bass hit rings out under the final frame

where_to_get_it.note: Search Hip Hop & Rap. Trim any track to 2 bars at the drop.
Many tracks have short 'stinger' versions already cut.

where_to_get_it.source: BeatStars or a producer on Fiverr
where_to_get_it.note: Ask for a 5-second sting at 96 BPM. It's yours alone.
Two bars of a drum loop + a scratch sample is enough.

music.sfx: Use the airhorn and buzzer from the recording app's sound effects, so the intro sounds like the show.
music.avoid: Commercial songs, even 5 seconds. Content ID will flag the episode.

characters.style: Flat 2D cartoon heads with thick black outlines, big expressive eyes and simple shapes. A little lopsided on purpose. No gradients, no 3D, no glossy AI look.

hosts.name: Ahsan
hosts.signature: Glowing laptop or phone (he built the game app)

hosts.name: Omar
hosts.signature: Fork with a bite of pancake (joined episode 1 from brunch)

characters.reference_photos: Take one front-facing photo of each host for hair, beard and glasses. Exaggerate one feature per person.

visual_style.logo: THREE IDIOTS in Helvetica Neue Bold, all caps, tight spacing, white on black. Matches the 'DON'T DO DRUGS.' shirt.
visual_style.motion: Snappy ease-out on every pop, 2–3 frames of squash and stretch, camera shake on the airhorn and the bonk. Every move starts on a beat.

shot_list.animation: Black screen. A white scratch line zips across the middle with the record scratch.
Ahsan's head pops up from the bottom left with a squash and bounce, laptop glow on his face.
Ahmad pops up in the center, airhorn raised.
Omar pops up on the right, mid-bite with a fork, looking at the camera like he got caught.
Ahmad blasts the airhorn: a red shockwave ring and camera shake. Ahsan and Omar's hair blows back.
THREE IDIOTS slams in above the heads one word per beat (THREE on 6, IDIOTS on 7), each with a 2-frame squash.
The three heads lean in and bonk together. Yellow stars spin, everyone's eyes go cross-eyed, and the frame holds on the logo.
shot_list.audio: Beat cuts out; bonk sound + one bass hit

per_episode_changes: None. The same 5 seconds plays every episode.
Optional for special episodes: swap one prop (a guest's head, a holiday hat)
build_steps: Pick or make the 2-bar beat at 96 BPM and export it as a 5.0 s WAV
Draw the three heads and the logo as separate layers (Procreate, Illustrator, Figma or Affinity)
Animate to the beat. Put a marker on every beat (every 18.75 frames at 30 fps) and start each move on a marker.
Tools: Jitter or Canva for a quick web version, After Effects or Procreate Dreams for hand-drawn polish, or Remotion if you want it built in code next to the app
Export 1920×1080 and 1080×1920 MP4s with the audio
Save the source files and the final MP4s to a shared drive (Google Drive or Dropbox), since they're too big for this repo
Or hire it out: search Fiverr or Contra for '2D podcast intro animation' and send this document as the brief
open_questions: Final show name, since 'Three Idiots' is a placeholder
Make the beat yourselves or buy a sting
Do the three of you approve your cartoon props?
